sources.title: DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813 official model card
sources.evidence: Identifies the exact 0813 GA release, superseding the preview, and explicitly states that it retains the preview structure with an attached DSpark speculative-decoding module. Publishes weights under MIT and documents reasoning controls.

sources.title: DeepSeek API change log
sources.evidence: The 2026-08-13 entry records the V4-Pro GA rollout to app, web and API. It documents low/high/max reasoning effort and Responses API support. The September entry explicitly continues V4-Pro service; retirement statements in secondary sources are stale.

sources.title: 0813 checkpoint index and indexed safetensors headers
sources.evidence: Retrieved all 66 indexed shard headers with byte-range requests; all 149,782 tensor names match the index. Applying the official FP4 packing and sharing rules gives 1,650,495,609,866 logical parameters: main 1,572,997,201,763 plus DSpark 77,498,408,103. Excludes 50,735,763,136 quantization-scale elements and 2,327,040 integer routing-table entries.

sources.title: 0813 reference Transformer and DSpark implementation
sources.evidence: Defines the causal Transformer, MoE blocks and three DSpark stages under mtp.*. Draft stages share the main embedding and prediction head. Integer tid2eid routing lookup is non-trainable. Attention sinks, compressor position embeddings, router biases and hyper-connection tensors are model parameters; linear quantization scales serve packed-weight reconstruction.

sources.title: 0813 checkpoint conversion and FP4 unpacking
sources.evidence: The conversion code expands each packed I8 element into two FP4 weights and handles quantization scales separately. This prevents treating packed storage elements as the logical model count.

sources.title: 0813 model configuration
sources.evidence: Specifies DeepseekV4ForCausalLM, 61 main layers, hidden size 7168, 384 routed experts, six selected experts per token and one shared expert. max_position_embeddings is 1,048,576; embeddings are untied. The legacy num_nextn_predict_layers=1 field does not describe the three DSpark checkpoint stages.

sources.title: 0813 reference inference configuration
sources.evidence: Explicitly configures n_mtp_layers=3 with DSpark enabled, matching checkpoint namespaces mtp.0 through mtp.2, and 61 main layers.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V4 technical report
sources.evidence: Defines the Pro Transformer MoE architecture, hybrid Compressed Sparse Attention and Heavily Compressed Attention, and manifold-constrained hyper-connections. Reports nominal 1.6T total and 49B activated parameters for V4-Pro. The exact 0813 card establishes structural continuity of the main model; the added DSpark component must be counted separately.

sources.title: DeepSeek API models and pricing
sources.evidence: The current table explicitly maps deepseek-v4-pro to DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813, advertises a 1M context, supports thinking/non-thinking and tool calls, and states that vision is unsupported. This verifies documented specifications, not a live endpoint invocation.

sources.title: 0813 prompt and output encoding
sources.evidence: Documents text chat, interleaved reasoning, non-thinking chat mode, and DSML tool calls for this exact checkpoint.

sources.title: 0813 MIT License
sources.evidence: The repository license grants MIT terms; the model card explicitly applies them to repository and model weights.

name.note: Catalog display spelling of the exact DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813 identifier.

developer.note: Released and maintained by DeepSeek in its official repository and API documentation.

family.note: Retains the catalog reasoning-family grouping; the official model lineage is DeepSeek V4 and this model supports thinking mode.

release_date.note: Explicit dated GA release entry, distinguished from the April preview.

open_weights.note: Official public repository contains the 0813 checkpoint shards and reference inference code.

license.note: MIT applies explicitly to the repository and model weights.

parameters_b.note: Complete logical checkpoint count in billions: 1,650,495,609,866 = 1,572,997,201,763 main + 77,498,408,103 DSpark. Counted every indexed shard header, unpacking I8 FP4 weights at two logical parameters per element; excluded .scale quantization metadata and integer tid2eid lookups. Shared embedding/head counted once. Includes learned hyper-connection scales, attention sinks and router biases. Evidence and reproducible count script are in /tmp/model-audit-183.

active_parameters_b.note: Developer-reported nominal activated count for the main V4-Pro model; the exact 0813 card explicitly preserves its structure. This is not an aggregate DSpark-assisted inference count. Draft execution cost depends on speculative decoding; no complete per-output-token active figure is asserted.

architecture.note: Causal Transformer with DeepSeekMoE, CSA/HCA hybrid attention and mHC. Main model: 61 layers, 384 routed experts with six selected and one shared expert per layer. Three additional DSpark stages are explicitly present in the checkpoint and inference config.

context_window.note: Retains the documented nominal 1M context. The exact checkpoint configuration ceiling is 1,048,576 positions; do not silently equate the rounded API label with an exact tokenizer limit.

modalities.note: Text causal language model and text conversation encoding; API table explicitly says vision is unsupported for this exact version.

reasoning.note: Thinking and non-thinking modes; reasoning effort supports low, high and max.

tool_call.note: Exact-version API table supports tool calls and checkpoint encoding documents DSML tool invocation and results.

patch.description: August 2026 general-availability DeepSeek V4 Pro MoE release with DSpark speculative decoding, million-token context, and thinking and non-thinking modes.

sources.label: 0813 checkpoint index and indexed safetensors headers

patch.notes: Complete checkpoint total is 1,650.495609866B logical parameters, including 1,572.997201763B main model and 77.498408103B DSpark. Quantization scales and 2,327,040 integer hash-routing entries are excluded; FP4 packed weights are expanded logically and the shared main embedding/head are counted once. The published 49B activated count is nominal for the main model, not total DSpark-assisted execution. Advertised context is 1M; checkpoint configuration allows 1,048,576 positions.

summary: Verified all 14 fields for the exact August 13 GA release. Added complete 1650.495609866B logical checkpoint count, nominal 49B main active count and MoE architecture; separated 77.498408103B DSpark. Preserved release date, MIT/open weights, reasoning family grouping, nominal 1M context, text modalities and reasoning/tool support. Clarified GA/DSpark description. No unresolved factual fields; DSpark aggregate active execution is intentionally not inferred.
